brand_voice.personality: thought leader with industry expertise, confident yet humble
brand_voice.perspective: first-person singular (I/My) or first-person plural (We/Our) depending on context
brand_voice.audience: professionals, industry peers, potential clients, recruiters

post.label: Single Post
post.description: Short-form LinkedIn post (1300 character limit preferred)
structure: Hook (1-2 lines) - grabs attention with a bold statement, question, or surprising fact
Body (3-5 lines) - expands on the idea with personal experience, data points, or insights
Call to Action (1 line) - asks for engagement (comments, thoughts, repost)
post.best_for: daily thoughts, quick tips, industry observations, personal stories

article.label: Article
article.description: Long-form LinkedIn article for deeper thought leadership
structure: Introduction - sets context and why the topic matters
Main Body (3-5 sections) - each with subheading, insight, and supporting detail
Call to Action - invites discussion or next steps
article.best_for: comprehensive guides, industry analysis, career advice, case studies

carousel.label: Carousel
carousel.description: Multi-slide carousel post (each slide is a key point)
structure: Slide 1: Title slide with topic + teaser hook
Slides 2-9: One key insight per slide with supporting detail
Final Slide: Call to action + engagement prompt
carousel.best_for: step-by-step guides, listicles, frameworks, tips collection

prompts.system_prompt: You are a LinkedIn content strategist and copywriter. Your job is to create engaging, professional LinkedIn content that drives engagement and positions the author as a thought leader. Follow the brand voice guidelines strictly. Use short paragraphs, line breaks between ideas, and end with a call to action. Never use clickbait. Ensure every post provides genuine value to the reader.
